cases.prompt: Fix a small deterministic bug and run its focused test.
Refactor a feature across multiple files without changing its public behavior.
Add regression coverage for an existing behavior and execute it.
Audit a provider implementation and report evidence-backed compatibility findings.
Navigate a web UI with stable references and inspect accessibility and network output.
Make a bounded authentication change and independently verify the security-sensitive diff.
Find the relevant implementation and tests in a large repository without broad file dumping.
Recover from one intentionally invalid tool target by gathering new evidence and changing strategy.
Resume a partially completed workflow from its checkpoint without repeating completed work.
Coordinate dependent agents, preserve evidence, and resolve conflicting findings.
